desc.en: A special metal that reacts to impacts. If formed into a sword, it converts the swinging impact into cutting force, while if it's made into a shield, it's said that it can repel any attack.
desc.ja: 衝撃を反響する特殊な金属。剣にすれば振った衝撃や切った衝撃を剣戟に変え、盾にすればあらゆる攻撃を弾くという

desc.en: Causes weapon to enhance attack power. Effect: Increases attack power by 15.
desc.ja: 武器の攻撃力を強化する。効果：攻撃力が１５上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Increases skill power and MP consumption by 17％.
desc.ja: 効果：スキルの威力と消費ＭＰが１７％上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Has a chance to cause Slow when dealing damage.
desc.ja: 効果：ダメージを与えた時、にする
